method.medians: Arithmetic middle-pair median across four runs; renderer/total use current comparison-report summaries, GPU-process CPU uses the same per-window seconds/wall-time conversion
method.pairedCpu: Exact current comparison-report pairedRatios: native/xterm matched by session/pair/repetition/path/count; full ratio/status/reason/ticks preserved
method.producerTotals: Numeric before/after/delta snapshots summed across terminals; availability counts preserved; gauge sums remain gauges; unavailable counters stay null
method.baseline: JavaScript WebGL producer at exact archived runtime commit; zero Zig/fallback counters are dormant

limitations: Output-only workload: input and write latency are unmeasured.
GPU-process CPU is CPU consumption, not GPU hardware execution time.
Prepare screenshots establish rendered qualification content; they do not show the final rolling output viewport.
Before/after windows are separate sessions; exact paired verdicts compare each native session with its own xterm controls.
